title: Customers and wallets
help: Create customer accounts and manage their rial wallets. Products, payment receipts and purchase delivery are being connected next.
noWallet: This customer has no wallet yet.
creditHelp: Zero prevents spending beyond the balance. A positive credit limit explicitly permits debt up to this amount. Lowering it below current debt is rejected.
adjustmentHelp: This changes the balance directly and records your reason. Receipt approval and automatic bank matching use separate workflows.
